summary: Representative-elect Eileen Laubacher has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. Their posts on AI are mostly about data centers, including tax breaks and their use of land, water and energy, and about the influence of Big Tech and the need for AI guardrails.

Representative-elect Jessica Killin has acknowledged serious risks from AI in general terms, without naming a catastrophic outcome. They have written of "the very valid concerns and threats AI poses" and support a pause on data centers until the threats AI poses to society and its energy and water use are better understood.

Representative-elect Manny Rutinel has acknowledged that AI could threaten human survival. They have written that AI companies are racing toward powerful models that could "lead us to an existential crisis" and that "Researchers building AI are telling us the risks could be existential." Their platform calls for independent safety reviews before major model releases.
Representative-elect Luke Bronin has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. Their statements on AI are about the economy: job cuts, job training as AI disrupts work, and AI concentrating wealth.
